'''Dropview Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. Its name originated from the fact that the cantina was located right on the edge of the [[Bridge city|bridge]] on which Jorra was built.<ref name="CotG" />

The Dropview was notable for being frequented by offworlders, while most other establishments in Jorra catered only to native [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]]. The cantina was also unusual for containing a large amount of [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] memorabilia, and for being backed by the [[Whitescar Syndicate]].<ref name="CotG" />
